analysis: national descriptive placement profile, no causal effects
target_definition: Accepted working_credit_present=True current2021 own physical additive settlement observations with effective population. Historical completeness and accepted coordinate availability are not required. All physical source rows are retained separately as inventory sensitivity.
sensitivity_rule: Keep full target denominator; reclassify WB observations whose accepted-vs-legacy point displacement exceeds1km or cannot be measured as unknown. Do not encode them as zero.
join_rule: Current commerce legacy id -> unique legacy source_record_id2021 -> exact accepted source_record_id2021; metadata conflicts are unknown. No legacy root/population/geometry used for accepted population or location.
population_rule: population_YYYY=accepted effective_population_YYYY; source-reported counts and overlay flags retained.
WB_rule: Positive means accepted WB types8/34 in current snapshot2026-10-21; zero accepted records is not proven physical absence or lack of service. No WB treatment assigned to2002/2010/2021.
trend_rule: Compare effective2002 vs2021: decrease/increase/unchanged; zero baseline separated; unknown retained. No historical completeness restriction.
source_scope: Territory and regions follow the accepted census source; region totals of federal cities are stored separately from physical settlement units. No full national territorial coverage claim follows from these counts.
limitations: Descriptive selection/placement, not influence on population or functional areas.
Snapshot lacks opening dates and consumer flows.
Unknown and zero accepted records do not establish absence.
Point-transfer sensitivity is a diagnostic; original source binding can still contain address errors.
Census historical values retain source quality flags; numerical availability does not prove longitudinal comparability.
Surrounding settlements can use another settlement pickup point; node presence is not household access.
